items.title: A morphism of algebraic stacks etale over a common base is etale

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for two algebraic stacks etale over a common base, every morphism between them over that base is etale (author lemma at source lines 8197-8202, label lemma-etale-permanence). The proof (source lines 8204-8229) makes the morphism DM, chooses compatible etale presentations over a smooth cover of the base, reduces to the induced morphism of algebraic spaces, and concludes by the version of the statement for algebraic spaces (proof lines 8205-8228). The construction of the compatible presentations and the reduction to algebraic spaces are the content. H3.
